catutthaekavacanassa tasma akarato ayadeso hoti va atthaya hitaya sukhaya devamanussanam buddho loke uppajjati ato ti kimattham isissa catutthi purisassa mukham ekavacanasse purisanam dadati data samanassa brahmanassa tuggahanen atthan ca atthattham hitattham sukhattham
And after the pronouns, the three are not [substituted].

na tehi akarantehi sma smim sa icc etesam aeayadesa honti sabbasma sabbasmim sabbassa yasma yasmim yassa tasma tasmim tassa kasma kasmim kassa imasma imasmim imassa ti kimattham papa pape papaya caggahanam anukaddhanattham

tasma gha to na dinam ekavacananam vibhattigananam aya deso hoti kannaya katam kammam diyate nissatam vattham pariggaho patitthitam silam ti kimattham rattiya itthiya dhenuya vadhuya iti kannam passati vijjam vinam gangam sabbasu yasu tasu kasu imasu pabhasu

tasma nadinam ekavacananam vibhattigananam yadeso hoti rattiya itthiya deviya dhenuya yaguya vadhuya iti kimattham ratti rattim itthi itthim ti kannaya vinaya gangaya pabhaya sobhaya rattinam itthinam
gassa tasma sakha to ga ssa kara karadesa honti bho sakhi sakhe
ghato tasma gha to ga ssa karadeso hoti bhoti ayye kanne kharadiye caggahanam avadharanattham sannitthanam
tato amma dito ga ssa karattam hoti bhoti anna amba tata ti kimattham kanne
After ‘la’ not shortened, ‘ve’ and ‘vo’ of the vocative ‘yo’.
yoalapanassa tasma la to yva lapanassa adesa honti bhikkhave bhikkhavo hetave hetavo ti kimattham sayambhuvo nagiyo dhenuyo yaguyo alapanasse te
tasma jhala to sa ssa vibhattissa adeso hoti aggino aggissa sakhino sakhissa dandino dandissa bhikkhuno bhikkhussa sayambhuno sayambhussa sasse ti kimattham isina bhikkhuna purisassa
And after ‘gha’ and ‘pa’, [there is] elision of ‘yo’.

tehi gha pa jha la icc etehi yo nam hoti va kanna kannayo ratti rattiyo itthi itthiyo yagu yaguyo vadhu vadhuyo aggi aggayo bhikkhu bhikkhavo sayambhu sayambhuvo atthi atthini ayu ayuni caggahanam anukaddhanattham
tasma la to yo nam vo karo hoti va bhikkhavo bhikkhu sayambhuvo sayambhu karaggahanam kimattham no jantuno caggahanam avadharanattham amu purisa titthanti purise passatha
sabbass eva amha saddassa adeso hoti vibhattimhi diyate purisena pariggaho
sabbass eva amha saddassa savibhattissa adeso hoti yo mhi gacchama dema amhasse ti kimattham purisa titthanti aham gacchami amhakam passasi tvam
sabbass eva ntu paccayassa savibhattissa adeso hoti yo mhi pathame gunavanto titthanti ntusse ti kimattham sabbe satta gacchanti gunavante passanti jana
sabbass eva ntu paccayassa savibhattissa deso hoti vibhattimhi silavantassa jhayino silavato ti kimattham silava titthati
sabbass eva ntu paccayassa savibhattissa adeso hoti si mhi vibhattimhi gunava pannava silava balava dhanava mahima satima dhitima ntusse ti kimattham puriso titthati silavanto titthanti

sabbass eva ntu paccayassa savibhattissa adeso hoti si mhi vibhattimhi vattamanassa gunavam cittam titthati rucimam puppham virocati simhi ti kimattham vannavantam agandhakam virulhapuppham passasi tvam
sabbass eva ntu paccayassa savibhattissa ama vanna honti pare bho gunavam gunava caggahanam anukaddhanattham

sabbass eva ntu paccayassa savibhattissa desa honti va sa smim na icc etesu yathasankhyam gunavato gunavantassa gunavati gunavantasmim gunavata gunavantena satimato satimantassa satimati satimantasmim satimata satimantena etesv iti kimattham gunava satima
sabbass eva ntu paccayassa savibhattissa adeso hoti nam mhi vibhattimhi gunavatam gunavantanam satimatam satimantanam ti kimattham gunavanto titthanti satimanto
In the neuter, when ‘aṃ’ and ‘si’ follow, “idaṃ” [of] “ima”.
imassa sabbass eva ima saddassa savibhattissa adeso hoti va amsi su vattamanassa cittam passasi titthati imam ti kimattham purisam ayam puriso
amussa sabbass eva amu saddassa savibhattissa adeso hoti amsi su napumsake vattamanassa puppham passasi virocati ti kimattham amum rajanam asu raja titthati
A numeral that is feminine, masculine and neuter.

sankhyanam itthipumanapumsake vattamananam savibhattinam hoti yo icc etesu itthiyo dhamma rupani yosv iti kimattham dvisu caggahanena duve dvaya ubha ubhaya duvi honti na am nam samana brahmana jana dvayena dvayam ubhinnam ubhayesam duvinnam
§133 Ti-catunnaṃ tisso catasso tayo cattāro tīṇi cattāri

tissocatassotayocattarotinicattari ticatu nnam sankhyanam itthipumanapumsake vattamananam savibhattinam icc ete adesa honti yathasankhyam yo etesu vedana disa jana purisa ayatanani ariyasaccani yosv iti kimattham tisu catusu
pancaadinam sankhyanam itthipumanapumsake vattamananam savibhattissa antassa sarassa karo hoti yo icc etesu panca cha satta attha nava dasa iti kimattham dve tayo
rannorajino sabbass eva raja saddassa savibhattissa icc ete adesa honti vibhattimhi ti kimattham ranna
sabbass eva raja saddassa savibhattissa adeso hoti nam mhi vibhattimhi rajunam idam rattham
sabbass eva raja saddassa savibhattissa adeso hoti na mhi vibhattimhi tena katam rajena ti kimattham ranno santakam
rannerajini sabbass eva raja saddassa savibhattissa icc ete adesa honti smim mhi vibhattimhi silam titthati
tumhaamhakam tayimayi sabbessam tumhaamha saddanam savibhattinam icc ete adesa honti yathasankhyam smim mhi vibhattimhi smimmhi ti kimattham tvam bhavasi aham bhavami
sabbesam tumhaamha saddanam savibhattinam icc ete adesa honti yathasankhyam si mhi vibhattimhi tvam aham ti kimattham tayi mayi caggahanena tuvam hoti sattha
sabbesam tumhaamha saddanam savibhattinam tava mama icc ete adesa honti yathasankhyam vibhattimhi ti kimattham tayi mayi
tuyhammayham sabbesam tumhaamha saddanam savibhattinam mayham icc ete adesa honti yathasankhyam se vibhattimhi dhanam diyate ti kimattham taya maya
sabbesam tumhaamha saddanam savibhattinam tam mam icc ete adesa honti yathasankhyam vibhattimhi ti kimattham taya maya
tavammamam sabbesam tumhaamha saddanam savibhattinam icc ete adesa honti yathasankhyam am mhi vibhattimhi mamam passati ti kimattham tam mam caggahanam anukaddhanattham
tayamaya sabbessam tumhaamha saddanam savibhattinam icc ete adesa honti yathasankhyam na mhi vibhattimhi katam ti kimattham tumhehi amhehi
sabbassa tumha saddassa savibhattissa tuvam tvam icc ete adesa honti am mhi vibhattimhi kalingarassa manne katthassa
After a word, when the second, fourth and sixth [inflections] follow, “vo” and “no”.

sabbesam tumhaamha saddanam savibhattinam yada padasma paresam adesa honti nava yathasankhyam dutiya catutthi chatthi icc etesu bahuvacanesu pahaya vo bhikkhave gamissami ma no ajja vikantimsu ranno suda mahanase evam dutiyatthe dhammam desessami samvibhajetha rajjena catutthyatthe tuttho smi pakatiya sattha bhagava anuppatto chatthyatthe ti kimattham eso amhakam tumhaamhakam iti ete isayo passasi tumhakam etesv gacchatha tumhe
And when [those inflections] follow in the singular, “te” and “me”.

ekavacanesu sabbesam tumhaamha saddanam savibhattinam yada padasma paresam te me adesa honti yathasankhyam catutthi chatthi icc etesu dadami gamavarani panca dadahi gamavaram idam rattham ayam putto padato ti kimattham tava nati mama
sabbesam tumhaamha saddanam savibhattinam yada padasma paresam teme adesa honti vibhattimhi passeyya tam vassasatam arogam so mam braviti
And optionally, in the third [singular inflection].
sabbesam tumhaamhasaddanam savibhattinam yada padasma paresam temeadesa honti yathasankhyam tatiyekavacane pare katam te papam me taya maya padato ti kimattham
vono sabbesam tumhaamha saddanam savibhattinam yada padasma paresam adesa honti yathasankhyam tatiyabahuvacanesu paresu katam kammam
When ‘si’ follows, ‘ā’ of the end of “puma”.
pumaantassa puma icc evam antassa savibhattissa adeso hoti si mhi vibhattimhi titthati ti kimattham pumano titthanti antaggahanena maghava yuva adinam
alapanaekavacane puma icc evam antassa savibhattissa amadeso hoti pare he pumam alapane ti kimattham ekavacane pumano
puma icc evam antassa am adeso hoti kate itthi napumsakam itthipumannapumsakani itthipumannapumsakanam samuho itthipumannapumsakasamuho ti kimattham itthipumanapumsakani
yosu puma icc evam antassa savibhattissa adeso hoti yo su vibhattisu pumano he iti kimattham
puma icc evam antassa savibhattissa adeso hoti smim mhi vibhattimhi pumane pume

puma icc evam antassa hi vibhattimhi ane adeso hoti pumanehi pumanebhi puna vibhatti ggahanam kimattham savibhattiggahana nivattanattham ggahanena maghava yuva evamadinam ana si yo am etesu vibhattisu pumakammathama ntassa karo sasma su maghavano maghavana maghavanam maghavane yuvano yuvana yuvanam yuvane pumuno pumuna kammuno kammuna thamuno thamuna
puma icc evam antassa su etasmim vibhattimhi adeso hoti pumasu pumesu
puma icc evam antassa au adesa honti va na mhi vibhattimhi pumana pumuna pumena caggahanam anukaddhanattham
And [there is] ‘a’ of the end [vowel] of “kamma”.

kammaantassa kamma icc evam antassa ua adesa honti va na mhi vibhattimhi kammuna kammana kammena ggahanena maghava yuva adeso hoti kvaci su etesu vibhattisu maghavana maghavasu maghavesu maghavena yuvana yuvasu yuvesu yuvena
tumhaamhehi tehi tumhaamhe hi vacanassa hoti tumhakam amhakam iti kimattham tumhehi amhehi
Optionally, ‘yo’ which is not the first.
yo tehi tumhaamhe hi akam hoti tumhakam passami tumhe amhakam passasi amhe ti kimattham tumhehi amhehi gacchatha gacchama mayam vikappanatthena nam am anam honti tumham tumhanam amham amhanam
sassa tehi tumhaamhe hi sa ssa vibhattissa adeso hoti va tumham diyate tava pariggaho amham mama sse ti kimattham tumhesu amhesu
After the letter ‘a’ of the pronouns, the first [is substituted by] ‘e’.

sabbanamaakarato sabbesam sabbanamanam karato yo ttam apajjate sabbe ye te ke tumhe amhe ime sabbanama ti kimattham deva asura naga gandhabba manussa akarato amu purisa titthanti sabbo so ko ayam pathama ggahanam uttarasuttattham
dvandaattha tasma sabbanam karato yo pathamo ttam apajjate katarakatame katarakatama sabbanama ti kimattham devasuranagagandhabbamanussa te sabbe
na annam sabbanamikanam dvandatthe kariyam hoti pubbaparanam pubbuttaranam adharuttaranam
samase sabbanamavidhanan nannam kariyam hoti piyapubbaya piyapubbanam piyapubbe piyapubbassa ce ti kimattham sabbanamavidhanam dakkhinapubbassam dakkhinapubbassa uttarapubbassam uttarapubbassa
After all [the pronouns], ‘naṃ’ [is substituted by] ‘saṃ’ and ‘sānaṃ’.

sabbanamato vacanassa sam sanam icc ete adesa honti sabbesam sabbesanam sabbasam sabbasanam yesam yesanam yasam yasanam tesam tesanam tasam tasanam kesam kesanam kasam kasanam imesam imesanam imasam imasanam amusam amusanam iti kimattham sabbassa yassa tassa kassa evam sabbattha
And when ‘su’, ‘naṃ’ and ‘hi’ follow, [there is] “rāju” of “rāja”.
sabbass eva raja saddassa adeso hoti su nam hi icc etesu rajusu rajunam rajuhi rajubhi sunamhisv iti kimattham caggahanam avadharanattham rajesu rajanam rajehi rajebhi
sabbassa imassa eva ima saddassa karo hoti su nam hi icc etesu esu imesu esam imesam ehi ebhi imehi imebhi imasse ti kimattham etesam etehi etebhi
anaimi ima saddassa sabbass eva ana imi icc ete adesa honti na mhi vibhattimhi anena dhammadanena sukhita hotu sa paja imina buddhapujena patva amatam padam ti kimattham imesu imesam imehi imebhi
When ‘si’ follows, [there is] ‘ayaṃ’ of the non-neuter [base].
anapumsakassa ayam ima saddassa sabbass eva adeso hoti si mhi vibhattimhi puriso itthi anapumsakasse ti kimattham idam cittam titthati imam purisam passasi tvam

amu saddassa anapumsakassa ma karo sa karam apajjate va si mhi vibhattimhi asu raja itthi amuko amuka anapumsakasse ti kimattham adum puppham virocati amusse ayam puriso titthati simhi amham purisam passasi
eta ta icc etesam anapumsakanam karo sa karam apajjate si mhi vibhattimhi eso puriso esa itthi so iti kimattham itaro itara etam cittam rupam tam
ta ssa sabbanamassa karassa na ttam hoti lingesu naya taya nam tam ne te nesu tesu namhi tamhi nahi tahi nabhi tabhi

sasmasmimsamsasu ta ssa sabbanamassa karassa sabbass eva ttam hoti va sa sma smim sam icc etesu sabbattha lingesu assa tassa asma tasma asmim tasmim assam tassam takara sse ti kimattham amussam amussa etesv iti nesu tesu
ima saddassa sabbass eva ttam hoti va sa sma smim sam icc etesu sabbattha lingesu assa imassa asma imasma asmim imasmim assam imissam imissa imasadda sse ti kimattham etissam etissa
sabbanamato ka karagamo hoti va si mhi vibhattimhi sabbako yako sako amuko asuko ti kimattham sabbo yo so puriso puna ggahanena annasma pi hinako potako

sabbato sabbanamato ghapa sannato smim sa icc etesam adesa honti va yathasankhyam sabbassam sabbassa sabbayam sabbaya imissam imissa imayam imaya amussam amussa amuyam amuya ti kimattham itthiyam itthiya smimsa nam iti amuyo
na etehi sabbanamehi ghapa sannehi vacanassa eva desa honti etissam etayam imissam imayam amussam amuyam smin ti kimattham taya itthiya mukham kannaya vinaya gangaya kapalikaya
After the group “mano” and others, [there are] ‘i’ and ‘ā’ of ‘smiṃ’ and ‘nā’.

ia tasma smim na icc etesam ikaraakaradesa honti va yathasankhyam manasi manasmim sirasi sirasmim manasa manena vacasa vacena sirasa sirena sarasa sarena tapasa tapena vayasa vayena yasasa yasena tejasa tejena urasa urena thamasa thamena smimna nam iti kimattham mano siro tamo tapo tejo adi ggahanena annasma pi kara karadesa bilasi bilasa padasi padasa
ca tasma mano ganadito sa ssa karo hoti manaso thamaso tapaso
When there is elision, [there is] ‘o’ of these.

mano ganadinam anto ttam apajjate vibhattilope kate manomayam ayomayam tejosamena tapogunena siroruhena adi ggahanam kimattham annesam aposamena vayosamena ti padasa tapasa yasasa vacasa manasa evam anne pi yojetabba
Optionally, when there is a vowel, [there is] insertion of ‘s’.
va eteh eva mano ganadihi vibhattadese pare karagamo hoti manasa vacasa manasi vacasi ti kimattham manena tejena yasena tejo yaso puna adi ggahanena annasmim pi paccaye akaragamo manasikam vacasikam

When ‘bh’ follows, [there is] ‘sa’ of the word “santa”, and ‘b’ at the end.
ca sabbassa santa saddassa sa karadeso hoti bh akare pare akaragamo sabbhir eva samasetha sabbhi kubbetha santhavam satam saddhammam annaya seyyo na papiyo
When ‘si’ follows, the suffix ‘nta’ of “gacchanta” and others [becomes] ‘aṃ’.
gacchantaadinam si mhi gacchanta dinam nta saddo apajjate va gaccham gacchanto maham mahanto caram caranto khadam khadanto iti kimattham anto danto vanto santo
iva gacchanta dinam nta saddo ppaccayo datthabbo vibhattippaccayesu gacchato mahato gacchati mahati gacchata mahata sesesv iti kimattham gaccham maham caram khadam
brahmaattasakharajaadito brahma atta sakha raja icc evamadito vacanassa hoti va brahmanam brahmam attanam attam sakhanam sakham rajanam rajam iti kimattham
si brahma atta sakha raja icc evamadito vacanassa hoti atuma
brahma atta sakha raja icc evamadito yo nam adeso hoti brahmano attano sakhano rajano atumano
ca ayono tasma sakha to yo nam adesa honti sakhayo sakhino yonam iti kimattham
tasma sakha to vacanassa karo hoti sakhe
tasma brahma to ga ssa karo hoti he brahme
When ‘no’, ‘nā’, ‘naṃ’ and ‘sa’ follow, [there is] ‘i’ of the end of “sakha”.
sakhaantassa tassa sakha ntassa karo hoti no na nam sa icc etesu sakhino sakhina sakhinam sakhissa etesv iti kimattham sakharehi
tassa sakha ntassa hoti hi mhi vibhattimhi sakharehi sakhehi
tassa sakha ntassa aro hoti su nam am icc etesu sakharesu sakhesu sakharanam sakhinam sakharam sakham
tasma brahma to vacanassa adeso hoti brahmani ggahanena abrahmato pi kammani cammani muddhani
tassa brahma saddassa anto ttam apajjate sa na icc etesu brahmuno brahmuna sanasv iti kimattham
And when ‘si’ follows, [there is] ‘ā’ of “satthu”, “pitu”, etc., and the elision of ‘si’.
satthupituadinam satthupitu adinam anto ttam apajjate si smim lopo hoti sattha pita mata bhata katta iti kimattham satthussa pitussa matussa bhatussa kattussa
annesu satthupitu adinam anto vacanesu ara ttam apajjate sattharam pitaram mataram bhataram kattaram sattharehi pitarehi matarehi bhatarehi kattarehi iti kimattham sattha pita mata bhata katta
satthupitu adinam anto ara ttam apajjate nam mhi vibhattimhi sattharanam pitaranam mataranam bhataranam ti kimattham satthanam pitunam matunam bhatunam

satthunam attam tassa satthu saddassa anto ttam apajjate va nam mhi vibhattimhi satthanam pitanam matanam bhatanam kattanam ti kimattham sattharanam pitaranam mataranam bhataranam dhitaranam ggahanam annesam pi sangahanattham
When ‘sa’ follows, [there is] ‘u’ and the elision of ‘sa’.
satthu pitu icc evamadinam antassa ttam hoti va sa smim lopo satthussa satthuno diyate pariggaho pitussa pituno bhatu bhatussa bhatuno ggahanam dutiyasampindanattham

sakkamandhatuadinam sakkamandhatu icc evamadinam anto ttam apajjate sa smim lopo hoti iva assa rajino vibhavo evam kattu gantu datu evamadi pun arambhaggahanam kimattham niccadipanattham ggahanam dutiyasampindanattham
ara desato sabbesam yo nam karadeso hoti sattharo pitaro mataro bhataro kattaro vattaro ggahanena annasma pi karo caturo jana gavo ubho purisa
ara desato vacanassa karadeso hoti satthari pitari matari dhitari bhatari kattari vattari puna gahanena annasma pi karo bhuvi
tato ara desato vacanassa adeso hoti satthara pitara matara bhatara dhitara kattara vattara
ara deso apajjate kare pare satthari pitari matari dhitari kattari vattari
When [an inflection] other than ‘si’ follows, of “pitu”, etc.
pituadinam pita dinam ara deso rassam apajjate asi mhi vibhattimhi pitara matara bhatara dhitara pitaro mataro bhataro dhitaro ggahanam to pare karadesanapanattham matito pitito bhatito duhitito
taya tayi icc etesam ta karo tva ttam apajjate tvaya tvayi iti kimattham tuvam tavam
When ‘hi’ follows, [there is] ‘ana’ of the end of “atta”.

attaanto tassa atta no anto ana ttam apajjate hi mhi vibhattimhi attanehi attanebhi ti kimattham rajehi rajebhi hismin iti attano bhavaniddesena saddassa saka deso hoti sabbasu vibhattisu sako sakam sake
tato atta to vacanassa hoti attana puna gahanena tassa no ta karass eva ra karo sabbesu vacanesu atrajo atrajam
jha la icc etehi sma vacanassa na hoti aggina dandina bhikkhuna sayambhuna ti kimattham aggayo munayo isayo
tasma ghapa to vacanassa hoti kannayam kannaya rattiyam rattiya itthiyam itthiya yaguyam yaguya vadhuyam vadhuya
After the neuter bases, [there is] ‘ni’ of ‘yo’.
sabbesam yo nam hoti va lingehi atthini atthi ayuni ayu ti kimattham itthiyo
karantehi napumsakalingehi yo nam ni hoti yani tani kani bhayani rupani
am karantehi napumsakalingehi vacanassa hoti niccam sabbam yam tam kam rupam
After the remaining ones, ‘ga’ and ‘si’ are also elided.
gasi api tato nidditthehi lingehi icc ete apajjante bhoti itthi sa bho dandi so sattha raja ti kimattham puriso gacchati itthiya satthussa
And after “āvuso”, the prefixes, the particles, etc., [there is elision] of all.

avusoupasagganipataadihi vibhattinam ekavacanabahuvacananam pathamadutiyatatiyacatutthipancamichatthisattaminam lopo hoti avuso upasagga nipata icc evamadihi tvam pan tumhe padaso dhammam vaceyya viharam sve upagaccheyya pa para ni du sam vi ava anu pari adhi abhi pati su ati api apa upa paharo parabhavo niharo uharo duharo samharo viharo avaharo anuharo pariharo adhiharo abhiharo patiharo suharo aharo atiharo apiharo apaharo upaharo evam visati upasaggehi yatha tatha khalu kho tatra atho atha hi tu va vo ham aham alam eva ho aho he ahe re are nipatehi yojetabbani caggahanam avadharanattham
In the compounds of “puma”, when [the word] “liṅga”, etc.
lingaadisu puma icc etassa anto lopam apajjate linga disu parapadesu pullingam pumbhavo punkokilo pumasse ti kimattham itthilingam napumsakalingam lingadisv iti pumitthi samase su lingam
vacanassa hoti va to pa sannato itthiyam itthim ti kimattham dandinam bhoginam iti itthihi
After ‘jha’ that has been shortened, [there is] ‘naṃ’.
tasma jha to am vacanassa hoti dandinam bhoginam ti kimattham vessabhum kucchim
sabbesam yo nam jha to katarassa hoti dandino bhogino he ti kimattham aggayo munayo isayo jhato sayambhuno yonan dandina bhogina
tasma jha to katarassa vacanassa adeso hoti dandini bhogini ti kimattham byadhimhi
kim icc etassa ko hoti va paccaye pare kva gato si tvam devanampiyatissa ggahanena pi tam ninditum arahati katham bodhayitum dhammam ti kimattham kuto agato
kim icc etassa hoti him ham etesu kuhim gacchasi kuham ggahanena hincanamdacanam paccayesu paresu annatthapi kuhincanam kudacanam
And when the remaining ones follow.
kim icc etassa ko hoti vibhattipaccayesu paresu pakaro katham kam pakaram caggahanam anukaddhanattham
kim icc etassa ku hoti tra to tha etesu kutra kuto kuttha caggahanam anukaddhanattham
sabbassa etassa akaro eta saddassa karo hoti to tha icc etesu ato attha etto ettha
sabbassa eta saddassa karo hoti tra paccaye pare atra
sabbassa eta saddassa karo hoti va to tha icc etesu etto ato ettha attha
And when ‘thaṃ’, ‘dāni’, ‘ha’, ‘to’ and ‘dha’ follow, [there is] ‘i’ of “ima”.
imassa ima saddassa sabbass eva karo hoti tham dani ha to dha icc etesu ittham idani iha ito idha
ima saddassa sabbass eva karo hoti dhuna mhi paccaye pare adhuna caggahanam avadharanattham
sabbass eva ima saddassa deso hoti rahi mhi paccaye pare etarahi
In the feminine, after ‘a’, [there is] the suffix ‘ā’.
vattamanaya karato paccayo hoti sabba ya sa ka katara
nadaadito nada dito itthiyam vattamanaya paccayo hoti nadi mahi kumari taruni sakhi itthi
nava nika neyya na ntu icc etehi itthiyam vattamanehi paccayo hoti manavi pandavi naviki venateyyi kunteyyi gotami gunavati samavati
After “pati”, “bhikkhu”, “rāja” and [the words] ending in the letter ‘ī’, [there is] ‘inī’.
patibhikkhurajaikarantehi patibhikkhuraji karantehi itthiyam vattamanehi paccayo hoti gahapatani bhikkhuni rajini hatthini dandini medhavini tapassini
sabbass eva ntu paccayassa ta karo hoti va kare pare gunavati gunavanti kulavati kulavanti satimati satimanti mahati mahanti gottamati gottamanti
sabbass eva bhavanta saddassa bhota deso hoti kare itthigate pare bhoti ayye kanne kharadiye

sabbass eva bhavanta saddassa adeso hoti pare purisa aggi raja sattha dandi sayambhu ti kimattham bhavata bhavam ggahanena annasmim pi vacane sabbassa bhonta bhante bhonto bhadde bhota bhoto icc ete adesa honti
‘Ā’ of the letter ‘a’ and of the end of “pitu”, etc.
akarapituadiantanam karo ca pita dinam anto ttam apajjate ge pare bho purisa raja mata sattha
jha la pa icc ete apajjante ge pare bho dandi sayambhu bhoti itthi vadhu
karo rassam apajjate ge pare bho raja atta sakha sattha
toadayo to adi yesam paccayanam te honti tva dayo paccaya vibhattisanna va datthabba sabbato yato tato kuto ato ito sabbada yada tada kada idha idani
Sometimes, [there is] ‘to’ in the meaning of the fifth.
pancamiatthe paccayo hoti sabbato yato tato kuto ato ito ti kimattham sabbasma imasma
After the pronouns, in the seventh, [there are] ‘tra’ and ‘tha’.
tra tha icc ete paccaya honti sattamyatthe sabbatra sabbattha yatra yattha tatra tattha
sabba icc etasma paccayo hoti kvaci sattamyatthe sabbadhi sabbasmim
kim icc etasma va paccayo hoti sattamyatthe kva gato si tvam devanam piyatissa
kim icc etasma him ham hincanam ete paccaya honti sattamyatthe kuhim kuham kuhincanam
ta mha him ham icc ete paccaya honti sattamyatthe tahim taham ggahanam hincana ggahananivattanattham
ima sma ha dha icc ete paccaya honti sattamyatthe iha idha caggahanam avadharanattham
tasma ya to paccayo hoti sattamyatthe yahim
kimsabbaannaekayakuhi kim sabba anna eka ya ku icc etehi da dacanam ete paccaya honti kale sattamyatthe kada sabbada annada ekada yada kudacanam
ta icc etasma da ete paccaya honti kale sattamyatthe tadani tada caggahanam anukaddhanattham
ima sma rahi dhuna dani icc ete paccaya honti kale sattamyatthe etarahi adhuna idani caggahanam anukaddhanattham
sabba icc etassa sa karadeso hoti da mhi paccaye pare sada sabbada
And when ‘ya’ follows, ‘a’ and ‘ā’ are elided.
lopam vanno paccaye pare apajjate bahussaccam pandiccam vepullam karunnam kosallam samannam sohajjam
iyaitthesu sabbass eva vuddha saddassa adeso hoti iya ittha icc etesu paccayesu jeyyo jettho
sabbass eva pasattha saddassa adeso hoti ja deso iya ittha icc etesu paccayesu seyyo settho jeyyo jettho
sabbassa antika saddassa neda deso hoti iya ittha icc etesu paccayesu nediyo nedittho
sabbassa balha saddassa sadha deso hoti iya ittha icc etesu paccayesu sadhiyo sadhittho
sabbassa appa saddassa adeso hoti iya ittha icc etesu paccayesu kaniyo kanittho
yuvanam sabbassa yuva saddassa kan adeso hoti iya ittha icc etesu paccayesu kaniyo kanittho caggahanam anukaddhanattham
And there is elision of “vantu”, “mantu” and “vī”.
vantumantuvinam vantu mantu vi icc etesam paccayanam hoti iya ittha etesu paccayesu guniyo gunittho satiyo satittho medhiyo medhittho
The consonants ‘t’, ‘l’, ‘ṇ’ and ‘d’ which have ‘y’ [become] the letters ‘c’, ‘l’, ‘ñ’ and ‘j’.

ya karavantanam talanada karanam calanaja karattam apajjante yathasankhyam bahussaccam pandiccam vepullam karunnam kosallam nepunnam samannam sohajjam yavata ti kimattham tinadalam talanadakarana iti alasyam arogyam maccuna kara ggahanam karassa ma karadesanapanattham opammam

amhatumhanturajabrahmaattasakhasatthupituadihi iva amha tumha ntu raja brahma atta sakha satthu pitu icc evamadihi vacanam datthabbam maya taya gunavata ranna brahmuna attana sakhina satthara pitara matara bhatara dhitara kattara vattara etehi ti kimattham purisa
§271 Yasmād apeti bhayam ādatte vā tad apādānaṃ
That from which [one] moves away, [from which] danger or fear [arises], or from which one takes: that is “apādāna”.
yasma tam jayate karakam apadanasannam hoti yatha gama apenti munayo nagara niggato raja cora acariyupajjhayehi sikkham ganhati sisso icc anena kvattho apadane pancami
[When there is connection with] roots and nouns, and when there is connection with prefixes and others, also [there is the starting point].

upasaggayogadisu payoge tam karakam apadanasannam hoti dhatunam tava ji icc etassa dhatussa para pubbassa yo asaho so apadanasanno yatha buddhasma parajenti annatitthiya bhu pa yato acchinnappabhavo himavata pabhavanti panca mahanadiyo anavatattamha mahasara aciravatiya kunnadiyo namappayoge pi urasma jato putto bhumito niggato raso ubhato sujato matito pitito upasaggayoge apasalaya ayanti vanija abrahmaloka saddo abbhuggacchati upari pabbata devo vassati pati sariputto dhammadesanaya bhikkhu alapati temasam ghatam assa telasma dadati uppalam padumasma kanakam hirannasma adiggahanena karakamajjhe pancamivibhatti ito pakkhasma vijjhati migam luddako kosa kunjaram masasma bhunjati bhojanam apiggahanena nipatapayoge dutiya tatiya rahita matuja punnam katva danam deti matujam matujena va rite saddhamma kuto sukham labhati saddhammam saddhammena te nana kula pabbajita vina natth anno koci natho loke vijjati buddham buddhena caggahanena annattha ham bhagini ariyaya jatiya sarami attanam patto smi vinnutam yatv adhikaranam enam cakkhundriyam asamvutam viharantam abhijjhadomanassa papaka akusala dhamma anvasaveyyum
That which is desired [in connection with] those meaning protection.
rakkhanaatthanam dhatunam payoge yam tam karakam apadanasannam hoti kake rakkhanti tandula yava patisedhenti gavo
Optionally, by whom not being seen [is desired].
adassanam icchitam tam karakam apadanasannam hoti upajjhaya antaradhayati sisso matara ca pitara putto ti kimattham sattamivibhatyattham jetavane bhagava

Far, near, measurement of distance and of time, elision of ‘tvā’, in connection with direction, comparison, abstinence, purity, liberation, cause, seclusion, measuring, in connection with the past, bondage, expression of quality, question, talk, little and no-agent.

kivaduro ito nalakaragamo durato agamma araka te moghapurisa imasma dhammavinaya dutiya tatiya duram gamam agato durena gamena va imam dhammavinayam anena dhammavinayena evamadi antikam gama asannam samipam saddhamma saddhammam saddhammena mathuraya catusu yojanesu sankassam nama nagaram atthi tattha bahu jana vasanti bhikkhave ekanavutikappe vipassi bhagava loke udapadi tinnam masanam accayena parinibbayissati kammadhikaranesu pasada sankameyya pasadam abhiruhitva pabbata pabbatam hatthikkhandha hatthikkhandham asana vutthaheyya asane nisiditva avicito yava upari bhavaggam antare sattanikaya yato khemam tato bhayam puratthimato dakkhinato pacchimato uttarato aggi pajjalanti assosum bhagavantam uddham padatala adho kesamatthaka panitataro visitthataro natthi chatthi yanti cagaya vipulam dhanam pannaya vimuttimano issariyaya janam rakkhati raja abhidhamma pucchanti abhidhammam sutva abhidhamme thatva vinaya vinayam vinaye abhidhammena vinayena evam sutta geyya gathaya veyyakarana udana itivuttaka jataka abbhutadhamma vedalla kathayanti thoka appamattaka kiccha thokena appamattakena kicchena kammassa katatta upacitatta ussannatta vipulatta cakkhuvinnanam §276 Yassa dātukāmo rocate dhārayate vā taṃ sampadānaṃ
To whom [one] wants to give, to whom [something] is pleasing, or for whom [one] holds [something]: that is “sampadāna”.

karakam sampadanasannam hoti samanassa civaram dadati saccam devadattassa suvannacchattam yannadatto icc anena kvattho sampadane catutthi ti vikappanattham dhatunamanam payoge upasaggappayoge nipatappayoge sati atthavikappanattham padam payujjati

‘Silāgha’, ‘hanu’, ‘ṭhā’, ‘sapa’, ‘dhāra’, ‘piha’, ‘kudha’, ‘duha’, ‘issa’ and ‘usūya’, ‘rādha’ and ‘ikkha’, in the former subject of ‘paccāsuṇa’ and ‘anupatigiṇa’, in the meaning of announcing, in the purpose of that, in the meaning of ‘tuṃ’, in the meaning of “alaṃ”, with ‘mañña’ in disrespect and in a non-living being, in the object [of roots] having the meaning of going, and in the meaning of benediction, with “sammuti”, with “bhiyya” and in the meanings of the seventh [inflection], also [there is “recipient”].

silaghahanuthasapadharapihakudhaduhaissausuyaradhaikkhapaccasunaanupatiginapubbakattuarocanatthatadatthatumatthaalamatthamannaanadaraappanini silagha hanu tha sapa dhara piha kudha duha issa icc etesam dhatunam payoge usuyatthanan radhikkhappayoge paccasunaanupatiginanam pubbakattari arocanatthe tadatthe tumatthe alamatthe mannatippayoge anadare appanini gatyatthanam kammani asisatthe sammuti bhiyya sattamyatthesu tam karakam sampadanasannam hoti silaghappayoge tava buddhassa silaghate dhammassa samghassa sakam upajjhayassa mama evamadi hanuppayoge hanute tuyham eva mayham thapayoge upatittheyya sakyaputtanam vaddhaki bhikkhussa bhunjantassa paniyena va vidhupanena bhikkhuni sapappayoge sapate dharappayoge suvannam te dharayate pihappayoge annatitthiya pihayanti deva dassanakama yato icchami bhaddantassa samiddhanam dalidda kudhaduhaissausuyappayoge kodhayati devadattassa tassa kujjha mahavira ma rattham vinassa idam duhayati disanam megho titthiya samananam issayanti gunagiddhena labhagiddhena dujjana gunavantanam usuyanti ka usuya vijanatam radha ikkha yassa akathitassa pucchanam kammavikkhyapanatthan dutiya aradho ham ranno rajanam ky aham ayyanam aparajjhami ayye cakkhum janassa dassanaya viya manne ayasmato upalittherassa upasampadapekkho upatisso ayasmantam suno tissa pacca yoge kammuno pubbassa yo katta so sampadanasanno yatha bhagava bhikkhu etad avoca ti akathitakammam etan kathitakammam karoti sa suttavacanena kattusanno evam bhagavato paccassosum asunanti gina ssa anupati janam dhammam saveti bhikkhuno jano anuginati patiginati vadeti vuttam kamman vuccati patiggahako sampadanam vijaniya arocayami vo bhikkhave amantayami pativedayami maharaja unassa paripuriya civaram nikkhipitabbam atthaya jivitam pariccajami lokanukampaya hitaya sukhaya devamanussanam buddho loke uppajjati bhikkhunam phasuviharaya vinayo pannatto alamatthappayoge alam iti arahati patikkhittesu me rajjam pattassa mallo mallassa patikkhitte rupam karaniyam hirannasuvannena katthassa tuvam kalingarassa kimattham gadrabham gamassa padena gato nagarassa appo saggaya gacchati saggassa gamanena mulaya patikasseyya samgho gamam nagaram saggam mulam dighayuko hotu bhaddam bhavato kusalam anamayam sukham svagatam attho hitam sammutippayoge annatra samghasammutiya vippavatthum na vattati sadhu bhiyyappayoge bhiyyoso mattaya sattamyatthe tuyhan assa avikaromi sakko patur ahosi atthaggahanena bahusu akkharappayogesu dissati upamam karissami desessami saratthe desetu bhante phasu viharaya etassa pahineyya no byakareyya tatha pi tesam byakarissama kappati ayogo amhakam manina kim buddhena seyyo bahupakara mahapajapatigotami matapitaro puttanam sesesu anne payoga payogavicakkhanehi yojetabba caggahanam vikappanatthavaggahananukaddhanattham ye keci sadda sampadanappayogika maya nopadittha gahanattham idha vikappiyati saddo bhikkhusamghassa pabhu ayam desassa raja khettassa gahapati arannassa luddako kvaci tatiya pancami chatthi
That which is the receptacle, that is “okāsa”.

adharo okasasannam hoti sv catubbidho byapiko opasilesiko vesayiko samipiko ca ti tattha tava jalesu khiram titthati tilesu telam ucchusu raso pariyanke raja seti asane upavittho samgho bhumisu manussa caranti antalikkhe vayu vayanti akase sakuna pakkhandanti vane hatthino gangayam ghoso vaje gavo duhanti savatthiyam viharati jetavane icc anena kvattho okase sattami
By means of this [one] does, that is “karaṇa”.

passati sunati karakam karanasannam hoti dattena vihim lunati vasiya kattham tacchati pharasuna rukkham chindati kudalena pathavim khanati satthena kammam karoti cakkhuna rupam sotena saddam icc anena kvattho karane tatiya
va passati sunati karakam kammasannam hoti chattam ratham rupam saddam kantakam maddati visam gilati icc anena kvattho kammatthe dutiya
The one who does, he is “kattā”.
so kattusanno hoti ahina dattho naro garulena hato nago buddhena jito maro upaguttena bandho kattu icc anena kvattho kattari ca
The one who causes to do, he is “hetu”.
so kattaram hetusanno hoti katta ca puriso tam purisam kammam tena purisena tassa purisassa evam hareti patheti paceti dhareti icc anena kvattho dhatuhi nenayanapenapaya karitani hetvatthe
The possession of that, this is “sāmī”.
samisannam hoti tassa bhikkhuno pativiso patto civaram attano mukham icc anena kvattho samismim chatthi
In the meaning of the base, the first [inflection].
lingaatthe lingatthabhidhanamatte pathamavibhatti hoti puriso purisa eko dve ca va he ahe re are
alapanatthadhike lingatthabhidhanamatte pathamavibhatti hoti bho purisa bhavanto raja rajano he sakhe sakhino
karanakarake tatiyavibhatti hoti aggina kutim jhapeti manasa ce padutthena pasannena kayena kammam karoti
sahaadiyoge sahadiyogatthe tatiyavibhatti hoti saha pi gaggena samgho uposatham kareyya vina mahata bhikkhusamghena saddhim sahassena samam mita
tatiyavibhatti hoti ranna hato poso yakkhena dinno varo ahina dattho naro
Also in the meaning of cause.
hetuatthe tatiyavibhatti hoti annena vasati dhammena vijjaya sakkarena
Also in the meaning of the seventh [inflection].
sattamiatthe tatiyavibhatti hoti tena kalena samayena yena kho pana
Deformation of a limb by that [part].
yena byadhimata angena angino vikaro lakkhiyate tattha tatiyavibhatti hoti akkhina kano hatthena kuni kanam passati nettena padena khanjo pitthiya khujjo
visesanatthe tatiyavibhatti hoti gottena gotamo natho suvannena abhirupo tapasa uttamo
sampadanakarake catutthivibhatti hoti buddhassa va dhammassa samghassa danam deti data samanassa brahmanassa
And also in connection with “namo”, homage, etc.
namoyogaadisu catutthivibhatti hoti namo te buddhavir atthu sotthi pajanam karohi nagassa svagatam maharaja
In the starting point, the fifth [inflection].
apadanakarake pancamivibhatti hoti papa cittam nivaraye abbha mutto va candima bhaya muccati so naro
Also in the meaning of cause.
karanaatthe pancamivibhatti hoti ananubodha appativedha catunnam ariyasaccanam yathabhutam adassana
In the meaning of the object, the second [inflection].
kammaatthe dutiyavibhatti hoti gavam hanati vihayo lunati sattham karoti ghatam ratham dhammam sunati buddham pujeti vacam bhasati tandulam pacati coram ghateti
In the constant conjunction of time and space.
kalaaddhanam dutiyavibhatti hoti masam mamsodanam bhunjati saradam ramaniya nadi sajjhayati yojanam vanaraji digho pabbato kosam ti kimattham samvacchare bhojanam
In connection with those that have indicated the action (kammappavacanīya).
kammappavacaniya yutte dutiyavibhatti hoti tam kho pana bhavantam gotamam evam kalyano kittisaddo abbhuggato pabbajitam anu pabbajimsu
Or in the causative of ‘gati’, ‘buddhi’, ‘bhuja’, ‘paṭha’, ‘hara’, ‘kara’, ‘si’, etc.
gatibuddhibhujapathaharakarasayaadinam payoge dutiyavibhatti hoti puriso purisam gamam gamayati purisena purisassa evam bodhayati bhojayati pathayati harayati karayati sayapayati sabbattha
chatthivibhatti hoti tassa bhikkhuno pativiso patto civaram attano mukham
okasakarake sattamivibhatti hoti gambhire odakantike papasmim ramati mano bhagavati brahmacariyam vussati kulaputto
samiissaraadhipatidayadasakkhipatibhupasutakusalehi sami issara adhipati dayada sakkhi patibhu pasuta kusala icc etehi payoge chatthivibhatti hoti sattami gonanam gonesu issaro dayado pasuto kusalo
niddharanatthe chatthivibhatti hoti sattami kanha gavinam sampannakhiratama gavisu sama narinam dassaniyatama narisu manussanam khattiyo suratamo manussesu pathikanam dhavanto sighatamo pathikesu
chatthivibhatti hoti sattami rudato darakassa pabbaji rudantasmim darake
Sometimes there is the second [inflection] in the meaning of the sixth [inflection].
dutiyavibhatti hoti api ssu mam aggivessana tisso upama patibhamsu
And [in the meaning] of the third and of the seventh [inflection].
tatiyasattaminam atthe kvaci dutiyavibhatti hoti sace mam samano gotamo alapissati tvan abhibhasasi evam tatiyatthe pubbanhasamayam nivasetva ekam samayam bhagava sattamyatthe

tatiyasattaminam atthe kvaci chatthivibhatti hoti kato me kalyano katam papam evam tatiyatthe kusala naccagitassa sikkhita caturitthiyo kusalo tvam rathassa angapaccanganam sattamyatthe ti kimattham yo vo ananda maya dhammo vinayo desito pannatto anando atthesu vicakkhano
And [in the meaning] of the second and of the fifth [inflection].

dutiyapancaminam atthe kvaci chatthivibhatti hoti tassa bhavanti vattaro sahasa kammassa kattaro evam dutiyatthe assavanata dhammassa parihayanti kinnu kho aham sukhassa bhayami sabbe tasanti dandassa bhayanti maccuno bhito catunnam asivisanam ghoravisanam ghoravisassa nagassa pancamyatthe
The seventh [inflection] in the meanings of object, instrument and cause.

kammakarananimittaatthesu sattamivibhatti hoti sundar avuso ime ajivaka bhikkhusu abhivadenti evam kammatthe hatthesu pindaya caranti pattesu pathesu gacchanti karanatthe dipi cammesu hannate kunjaro dantesu nimittatthe
sattamivibhatti hoti samghe dinnam mahapphalam gotami dehi te dinne ahan eva pujito bhavissami
Also in the meaning of the fifth [inflection].
pancamiatthe sattamivibhatti hoti kadalisu gaje rakkhanti
kattari payujjamane sattamivibhatti hoti pubbanhasamaye gato sayanhasamaye agato bhikkhusu bhojiyamanesu bhuttesu gosu duyhamanesu duddhasu
In the expression of excess (“adhika”) and of authority (“issara”) in connection with ‘upa’ and ‘adhi’.
upaadhi adhikaissaravacane upa adhi icc etesam payoge sattamivibhatti hoti khariyam dono nikkhe kahapanam brahmadatte pancala naccesu gotami devesu buddho
manditaussukkesu mandita ussukka icc etesv atthesu tatiyavibhatti hoti sattami ca nanena pasidito nanasmim va ussukko tathagato tathagatagotto
The connected meaning of nouns [has the name] “samāsa” (compound).

tesam payujjamanapadatthanam yo so samasasanno hoti kathinadussam agantukabhattam jivitindriyam samanabrahmana sariputtamoggallana brahmanagahapatika iti kimattham devadatto pacati yannadatto ti bhato ranno putto devadattassa samasa icc anena kvattho kvaci samasantagatanam akaranto
And the inflections of those are elided.

yuttatthanam samasanam honti kathinadussam agantukabhattam gahanena samasataddhitakhyatakitakanam vibhattipaccayapadakkharagama vasittho venateyyo ggahanam avadharanattham pabhankaro amantandado medhankaro dipankaro
And there is the original form of those that end in a vowel.
ca luttasu vibhattisu lingassa pakatirupani honti cakkhusotam mukhanasikam rajaputto rajapuriso
That which has a prefix or a particle in front is an “abyayībhāva” (adverbial compound).
